name: session-skills
description: Seven skills for working inside one conversation: play back a brain dump, explain it simply, get grilled on it, check the spec before building, hand it off, recap it, and track what is still open.

interface.shortDescription: Play back a brain dump, explain it simply, get grilled on it, check the spec, hand it off, recap it, track what is open.
interface.longDescription: Everything you reach for inside one conversation, in one install. braindump plays back a pasted brain dump in very simple words and waits for your yes before any work starts. explain-simply re-says the last answer as short bullets keeping every number and file path. grill-me runs a discovery interview one question at a time, checkpointing each answer to a persistent file. handoff reviews persistent information with short approval bullets, then writes a self-contained prompt for a fresh session, checked by a second agent first. session-summary returns a table of what you asked for and an honest status for each. track-tasks keeps every still-open topic on the built-in task list so nothing raised mid-session is lost. spec-check reviews the specification you are about to build from, flags anything that could skew the work, and fixes it with your approval before building starts.
defaultPrompt: What is still open in this session?
Write me a handoff before I clear context
